name: Sárosd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sárosd: a green shield with a white bird and a red charge, with a helm, a sabre crest and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sárosd arms with helm, crest and mantling
